Inherited retinal dystrophy causing profound congenital visual impairment; no additional organ involvement established.
Inherited defective maturation and mineralization of dental enamel; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.

Degeneration of the retinal macula; complement-associated genetic susceptibility does not itself establish autoimmune disease.

Congenital skeletal muscle fiber disease; respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness. Strabismus without intrinsic eye damage does not establish another axis.
Atrophy directly affects the lacrimal apparatus, part of the ocular axis.
Bilateral congenital shortening of toe bones; explicitly nonsyndromic.
Inherited renal tubulointerstitial disease progressing to kidney failure; no extrarenal damage established for this subtype.
Congenital protrusion of meninges through a structural defect of the spinal column or cranium defines both axes.
Neurodevelopmental disorder defined by persistent social-communication deficits and restricted repetitive behavior.
Malignant B-cell lymphoid neoplasm, primarily nodal; lymphoma requires the immune mechanism axis. No additional organ damage is established in most patients.
